Renamed `totalAmount` → `grossAmount` across both sides of the API seam:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `api/.../Order.java:15,27` | JPA entity field + `getTotalAmount()` → `getGrossAmount()` |
| `api/.../OrderDto.java:5,8` | record component + call site |
| `api/.../order.graphqls:4` | schema field |
| `web/src/lib/orders.ts:6,25` | GraphQL query selection + `Order` interface |
| `web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` | generated type |
| `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx:4,12` | reduce accumulator + rendered cell |

Verified: `mvn test` — BUILD SUCCESS, 1 test passing; `tsc --noEmit` — clean; `vitest run` — 1 test passing. (Both test files deliberately avoid naming the amount field, so neither needed changing.)

Two things to flag:

- **The DB column changes.** `Order` is a `@Entity` with no `@Column` annotation, so Hibernate derives the column name from the field: `total_amount` becomes `gross_amount`. There's no migration tooling in the repo and `ddl-auto` isn't configured anywhere I could find, so against an existing database this rename will break at runtime, not compile time. If the column should stay put, add `@Column(name = "total_amount")` to the field; otherwise this needs a migration.
- **`graphql-generated.ts` is a checked-in artifact.** Its header says it's regenerated from `order.graphqls` on every build, but no codegen is actually wired up (`build` is just `tsc --noEmit`), so I hand-edited it to match what codegen would emit. If you do have a codegen step outside this repo, re-run it to confirm.

I left the `totalAmount` mention in the `orders.test.ts` doc comment — it describes the rename task itself rather than referring to the live field, so updating it would make the sentence say the field was renamed to its own new name. Say the word if you'd rather it be reworded.
